doc.title: Bernie Kirsh interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 27, 2022

chapter: Producers, Chick's legacy and the music business
title: Listening habits after a long session
summary: What Kirsh listens to, or doesn't, after long sessions.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: If you were doing a twelve hour session and you finally got home what do you like to hear afterwards?

You know I don’t know that I hear anything except my pillow. I think that that’s where I go. I don’t put on — I mean if I’m sitting and working I’ll put on music and — if I’m doing administrative stuff I’ll do that. But you know it’s interesting you say that. I don’t sit — I do from time to time but not like I used to where I would sit and put an album on and just sit on the sofa and just listen to the whole album through. It seems to be a little more piecemeal these days. I don’t know, how do you find it?
Same. Exactly the same. Yeah. I mean I play music a lot for a living so I don’t necessarily listen to music as much as a lot of people would.
Well probably the same for me. But yeah.
